Rugan is a human agent of the Zhentarim trapped in a cave on the Risen Road, desperately trying to fend off  Flind's gnoll pack.

Involvement

Act One

Rugan and  Olly are taking shelter in a cave while under attack from  Flind and her gnoll pack. The party can intervene, saving the two Zhentarim agents, or convince the gnolls to enter the cave and kill them through various dialogue checks with Flind.

  • Divert her attention to the cave - perhaps there's more meat inside?
    • [ILLITHID] [WISDOM] Use the power within you to make her obey the Voice; to brave the flames and feast on the meat in the cave. (DC 5)
    • [BARD] [PERFORMANCE] Conjure the mewlings of easy prey into her mind, centring it within the nearby cave. (DC 12)
  • Search her mind for the source of the Voice.
    • [WISDOM] Harness her anger - the meat in the cave must die. (DC 10)

If the party initiate combat with the gnolls, come Rugan or Olly's turn, they retreat further into the cave and disengage from initiative. They do not fully engage with the party unless the gnolls are defeated. After the battle, Rugan runs out of the cave, thanks the party for their assistance and reveals that they are part of a caravan to Baldur's Gate. There, it is unveiled that Rugan and Olly are transporting a  Caravan Strongbox. During this interaction, the party can recognise Rugan as part of the Zhentarim merchant network. In most cases, he gives the party the password (little serpent, long shadow) to enter the Zhentarim Hideout beneath Waukeen's Rest.

Rugan's dialogue tree is extensive and non-linear, with every branch of his tree linked together; the party can steal the cargo, have multiple opportunities to convince him to give it up, demand gold, or let him keep it.

  • What's in the chest? Your cargo? / I'll stay friendly - so long as you hand over all your goods.
    • [INTIMIDATION] Whatever your cargo is, I'll take it as payment. (DC 15) / [INTIMIDATION] The cargo. Give it to me. Or else. (DC 15)
      • Zhentarim agents guarding a single chest. Curious. / The Zhentarim aren't known for mercy, true.
        • [BERSERKER] [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] ROAR. (DC 15)
        • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Enough talking. I'll have that cargo, or I'll have your head. (DC 15)
        • [INTIMIDATION] No. This is the point where I stop asking, and start cutting. (DC 15)
        • [PERSUASION] This is your employer's mess - but we can profit. Let's sell the cargo ourselves. (DC 15)
        • [ROGUE] [PERSUASION] You're missing a golden opportunity. Report the cargo lost - and we can sell it ourselves. (DC 15)
        • [OATHBREAKER] [PALADIN] [INTIMIDATION] Whatever oath you've sworn to the Black Hand, it's not worth dying for. Give me the cargo. (DC 15)
        • [PALADIN] [INTIMIDATION] You serve your oath to the Zhent impressively, but I'm afraid I'll be taking that cargo. Now. (DC 15)
        • [BARD] [PERSUASION] You'll find I'm very persuasive. We can make much more coin than you would with your employers. (DC 12)
      • If your bosses come after the chest, I'll kill them as well.
        • You had your chance. Either way, that cargo's mine.
    • [BARD] [DECEPTION] Darkhold was getting concerned. I've been sent to retrieve the shipment. (DC 15)
  • [BERSERKER] [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] WORDS DON'T PAY. COIN DOES. (DC 10)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Not looking for new friends. Looking for coin. Now. (DC 10)

If the party have already been to the Zhentarim hideout, the following dialogue options are available as well:

  • [INTIMIDATION] Fair. But I expect to be paid for saving your life. (DC 5)
  • [INTIMIDATION] You can leave - but your cargo stays. (DC 10)
  • [BERSERKER] [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] PAY UP. (DC 5)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Coin first. Then I go. (DC 5)
  • [BERSERKER] [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] CARGO'S MINE NOW. GET OUT. (DC 10)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Cargo's mine now. Goodbye. (DC 10)

Receiving the quest to ⁠Find the Missing Shipment gives the following options:

  • All dead. Zarys sent me to secure the cargo. / Zarys sent me to secure the cargo.
    • This isn't a rescue, it's a robbery. I want the chest.
    • [BERSERKER] [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] CHEST. MINE NOW. (DC 15) (leads back to the first dialogue branch)
    • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] The chest is mine now. Only question is if you live or not. (DC 15) (leads back to the first dialogue branch)
    • [INTIMIDATION] You owe me more than a drink. How about some coin? (DC 10)
    • [BERSERKER] [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] MONEY, OR YOUR LIFE. CHOOSE. (DC 10)
    • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] I'll buy my own drinks. Money. Now. (DC 10)

Should the party take the chest or its contents, Rugan moves to the Zhentarim hideout and is tied to a chair, being beaten by another Zhent.  Zarys berates Rugan for losing the cargo before threatening to kill the party. Zarys also reveals during the conversation that Rugan was the one who got her to join the Zhentarim. The party can either attack the Zhents, or convince Zarys not to attack. Nevertheless, any peaceful conclusion results in Zarys asking the party to kill Rugan. Rugan then begs the party to end his suffering; the party can either kill or release him. Releasing Rugan causes the other Zhentarim to immediately become hostile. Rugan aids the party in the ensuing fight, but flees immediately after its conclusion.

If Rugan keeps the Caravan Strongbox, he moves with Olly (provided Olly survived as well) next to Zarys in the hideout. The Zhentarim greet the party as friends and allow them to go through their better items when trading with  Brem. Rugan then makes a promise to buy the party a drink at the Elfsong Tavern once they are back in Baldur's Gate.

Act Three

This article is about gameplay elements – such as characters, quests or mechanics – that have been removed from the game and are no longer available.
Main article: Cut and unimplemented content: Rugan

By saving Rugan from the gnolls in Act One, and remaining on friendly terms with the Zhents at the hideout, the party would have originally been able to find him in the Guildhall alongside both members of The Guild and the other Zhents; tipsy and dejected, he would attempt to celebrate the party's arrival by telling the Zhents around him his rescue from the gnolls by the party, only to get ignored by everyone around him.

Rugan then would have revealed that the original Zhentarim in Baldur's Gate were backstabbed and put under "new management" in an internal power play, with every single Zhent returning to the city being betrayed, turned to the Steel Watch, and then hanged. He would have explained that their new superiors thought they were responsible for the kidnapping of  Duke Ravengard, and that he owes his survival to falsely confessing as though it was true. As he is still loyal to the Zhentarim despite all this, the party then would have been able to convince him to leave their ranks.

  • [PERSUASION] The Zhentarim have brought you nothing but trouble, Rugan. Cut your losses. (DC 15)
  • [ROGUE] [PERSUASION] The Zhentarim sold your friends out. You think they wouldn't do the same to you? (DC 10)
  • [ROGUE] [PERSUASION] The Zhentarim made you turn on your people. You really think you owe them loyalty? (DC 10)

Successfully doing so would have make him move away from his posting in the Guildhall, and head towards the bar where he would have started drinking. During the Zhentarim's attempted takeover of the Guild, Rugan would not have joined combat and instead kept drinking if he was swayed away from the Zhentarim.

Speak with Dead

Rugan can be communed with using  Speak with Dead. If a party member kills Rugan, they do not need to disguise themselves to speak to his corpse.

  • Who are you?
    • Rugan
      ... Rugan... Zhentarim agent...
  • What happened here?
    • Rugan
      ... some... killer... looked a lot like you... (If killed by the Player)
    • Rugan
      ... Zarys... your... fault... (If Rugan left the cave)
    • Rugan
      ... ambushed... gnolls... saved cargo...
  • Where were you heading?
    • Rugan
      ... tavern... Zhentarim hideout...
      • And how do I find this hideout?
        • Rugan
          ... beneath tavern... need password...
          • What's the password?
            • Rugan
              ... little serpent... long shadow...
  • What's inside the cargo? (If chest was touched)
    • Rugan
      ... wizard's shipment... secret... dangerous...
